title: The lost-PR ledger writes even when a state-f branch shares no history with main
why: merge --ledger stops with unsorted: unknown-read and writes nothing, because 13 state-f branches have no merge base with main (git diff ...: no merge base). The ledger publish is blocked by it.
note: Filed by triage 11, 14:08 CST Nov 17. Prior work: lost-work-sweep (#3528), lost-work-f-skip-record-branch (#3605, skips record branches by name only). Found by a builder run: rows brief/align-watchers, dead-pr-waits-place, handoff/dropped-start-alarm, handoff/precommit-secrets-symlinks, handoff/small-text-skips-designer, merge-lock/stable, merge-notes/commit-refuses-conflict-markers, merge-notes/notes-fix-large-1, merge-notes/notes-fix-page, restart-plan, rulings-store-parses, updatedat-not-future, worktree-agent-a14b2fddf62c05643. Fix: a no-merge-base branch gets a files value instead of an unknown read; any other failed read still stops the ledger. Lane: test-author first (branch lane/ledger-no-merge-base-tests), then builder, then review (program logic). Verdicts file: origin branch backlog-drain-ledger docs/plans/backlog-drain/verdicts.txt. Ledger ledger-build needs about 10 min of fetching. PR class (triage 11, 22:01 CST Nov 17): none; the saved match run did not cover this step. 01:43 CST Nov 18: PR #3627 merged 01:43:49 CST, merge commit 88f3fe872515, 4 commits, head 71b67dd586, runner 10 (REST: merged true; coordinator 01:45 CST relay). Review: round 1 FAIL fixed, round 2 PASS. Non-blocking, from the review: nothing pins the unknown shallow probe; the shallow why line names no remedy. Ledger run 05:40 CST Nov 18 (triage 11, merge tool on main 88f3fe8725, live file read 04:26 CST): four runs; the fourth ran 73 min and refused to write, 89 rows unknown: 'the live file has no threads list' (the committed live file has none either; the threads are the project's chat threads, which triage cannot read) and 'the footer names a session the live file's lanes do not list' (triage refreshed only the newest 100 of 2,304 sessions). Runs one to three failed on time limits and a stale live file (limit 60 min). Needs a threads list and the full session list, or an owner ruling that unread rows may be written as unknown.
